name: agentlift
description: Measure the real impact of agent extensions.

scripts.impact:openai: npm run build && node dist/cli.js impact --config examples/openai-agentlift.yaml
scripts.demo:claude: npm run build && node dist/cli.js impact --config examples/claude/offline-skill.yaml && node dist/cli.js impact --config examples/claude/offline-mcp.yaml
scripts.impact:claude:skill: npm run build && node dist/cli.js impact --config examples/claude/skill.yaml
scripts.impact:claude:mcp: npm run build && node dist/cli.js impact --config examples/claude/mcp.yaml
